payload.text: AI shall be used in accordance with federal and State laws, Board of Education of Anne Arundel County (Board) policies and administrative regulations, and the AACPS Strategic Plan.
AI shall be used in ways that enhance, and never replace, the professional judgment of employees.

AI used by AACPS shall serve a clear educational or operational purpose; protect the rights and safety of students, employees, parents/guardians, and other stakeholders; and comply with applicable federal and State laws and Board polices and AACPS administrative regulations.
AI shall support, and may not replace, the professional expertise and responsibilities of employees and stakeholders.
Any AI output used in a consequential decision affecting a student or employee shall be subject to documented human oversight.
Employees and stakeholders retain the authority and responsibility to interpret, contextualize, override, or reject AI outputs.
AI may only be used for approved administrative, educational, and operational purposes in AACPS.

payload.text: AI shall be used to expand equitable access to opportunity.
payload.section_path: DM - RESPONSIBLE USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE Page 2 of 2

payload.text: AACPS shall monitor AI tools for biased, discrimination, or inequitable outcomes and take corrective action where disparities emerge.
payload.section_path: DM - RESPONSIBLE USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE Page 2 of 2

payload.text: AACPS shall establish expectations, conditions, and limitations for student use of AI.
payload.section_path: DM - RESPONSIBLE USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE Page 2 of 2

payload.text: AACPS shall provide role-specific professional learning so that employees can use AI safely, ethically, and effectively.
payload.section_path: DM - RESPONSIBLE USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE Page 2 of 2

payload.text: Professional learning shall emphasize critical evaluation of AI outputs, protection of student data, and recognition of when AI use is inappropriate.
payload.section_path: DM - RESPONSIBLE USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE Page 2 of 2

payload.text: AI tools shall be vetted before adoption for educational value, data practices, accessibility, and compliance with applicable federal and State laws and Board policies and administrative regulations.
payload.section_path: DM - RESPONSIBLE USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE Page 2 of 2

payload.text: AACPS shall communicate with students, parents/guardians, employees, and other stakeholders the AI tools used, data collection and retention practices, and when optout options apply.
